messages:
Alex: nightly eval alert — retrieval top-5 recall drop ~11.8% for instructor-embeddings + reranker pipeline compared to baseline (2026-03-12).

Alex: saw it spike in the RAG nightly report for docs-prod-sys. Curious if it’s embeddings shift or reranker weights.

eval-bot: nightly-eval job 2026-03-20/03:12 finished. Summary: retrieval_topk_recall@5 decreased 0.118 vs baseline. Link: https://ci/redwood/nightly/2026-03-20/12345

Maria: is there a recent reranker rollout?

Jordan: pushed reranker training change on 2026-03-18 — commit c4a9b7d — added aggressive hard-negative mining and changed label sampling. Could affect calibration.

Alex: ok, thanks. also we rolled instructor-embed quantization on 03-17 (Q4 int8 path). Running quick checks now.

Sam: samples from the failing set:
```
Query: "how to configure vpc peering for private deployment"
Ground truth doc: doc_id=84012
Old pipeline topk: [84012, 83201, 81000] (sim scores [0.84,0.77,0.73])
New pipeline topk: [83201, 72344, 90011] (sim scores [0.42,0.39,0.35])
Reranker score old: 0.88 -> new: 0.45
```

Maria: who ran the quantization change? could be underflowing norms. Can you dump L2 norm distrib?

Alex: ran quick stat: baseline mean L2=12.3 +/- 2.1, current mean L2=7.9 +/- 1.8. big downshift.

Jordan: that’s suspicious. quant path Q4 int8 can reduce magnitude unless scale corrected. But reranker change could amplify low sim scores.

Alex: command I ran: `python tools/embeddings/compare_stats.py --baseline=2026-03-12 --current=2026-03-20 --model=instructor-v1` outputs attached (summary).

Alex: also pulled 50 random failures — cosine sims all down ~0.4 average drop.

Sam: quick mitigation: revert reranker weights on staging and re-run nightly. Or disable quantized path for production for instructor-embeds. Which is lower risk?

Maria: revert reranker on staging first (fast). If sims still low, it's embeddings. If revert fixes reranker scores but sims remain low, then embeddings are main cause.

Jordan: I can prepare a rollback PR for reranker (revert c4a9b7d) — should be safe and quick.

Alex: +1. Also let’s run embedding raw-vector consistency check: `curl -sS https://embed-service/internal/vec?ids=84012,83201 | jq .` and compare norms.

eval-bot: scheduled follow-up job: `retrieval-debug/compare-topk` queued with tags [instructor-embed, reranker-revert-test]. Run id: 2026-03-20-ev-78.

Sam: created a small repro set in /mnt/eval/repro/instructor-topk-20. Please add any more failing queries.

Alex: OK adding a few more. If rollback looks clean, we’ll then run the quant-path A/B to see which one causes the bigger delta.

Maria: FYI — customers using private deployment saw a small uptick in support pings this morning; correlated with same timeframe. cc @support.

Jordan: rolling the reranker revert to staging now. will ping when done.

Alex: thanks. next steps: (1) reranker revert on staging + nightly; (2) run quant vs fp32 embed A/B on small sample; (3) collect reranker score distribution. I’ll compile a short triage doc after results. :mag:
